additional_info.subject: ID0476913-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2/T94002918017] Chargerpoint 1 isnt available CRM:03289000478
additional_info.body:
Dear Alexander,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, we see that the charger is offline right now. The SCB connection with our system is lost, and this means we are not able to see any updates regarding the charger.
Are you able to turn the SCB connection online again? And let us know when this is the case.
When the SCB connection is online again, we are able to check the outlets, and resolve the issue.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
